name: Masters of Innovation Summer Camp
description_short: A week by week maker camp in The Masters School's Innovation and Entrepreneurship Center in Dobbs Ferry for Masters students entering grades 5 to 8. Each week stands alone: robotics and video game design, building and racing CO2 cars, or a design studio for personal projects, ending in a showcase for families.
refund_policy_summary: Tuition is 50% refundable up to one month before camp.

sessions.name: Session 1: Robotics, Programming & Video Game Design

notes: The page is headed 'For Masters Students Entering Grades 5 to 8' and does not say whether students from other schools may enroll. Hours 9 to 3; early drop off 8:30 and late pick up to 3:30 are $50 each per week ($40 in week 1). 4 to 1 camper to staff ratio.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2027 sessions and tuition; ages derived from grades 5 to 8.
